title: Aspen Search city time and clock
description: The live time in a city as plain text, and a thin round clock face whose two hairline hands show it; both update every 15 seconds.
notes: needs JavaScript for the live time; static HTML shows the fallback time
name: aspensearch-city-time

props.name: fallback
props.description: what static HTML shows before the live time takes over, e.g. "09:00 AM"
